section.10: The Book of Leading the Prayer (Al-Imamah)

10.name_native: The Book of Leading the Prayer (Al-Imamah)

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Anas said:"The Iqamah for prayer was said, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was conversing privately with a man, and did not commence the prayer until the people slept
